declared.description: The run's samples are the samplesheet's (`true`), or only those tasks named so far.

samples.description: Samples in the samplesheet's order, then any others seen, by id.

study.description: Whole-study steps' cells, keyed by group.

unattributed.description: Tasks in a per-sample step that name no sample (biffix could not match them).

attempts.description: Attempts across the cell's tasks (more than its task count means a retry).

CellState.description: A grid cell: one sample's step (or a whole-study step).

oneOf.description: Satisfied from an earlier run's results (every task cached).

cells.description: Keyed by step group; a step the sample has no task in yet is absent.

oneOf.description: No task yet (the run is still going).

Did not finish because the run ended: the run failed or was cancelled first, or (a sheet
sample no task ever named) it never ran.

authored.description:
`label` is the author's, not one made from the group name: a client may word a made one
its own way, but shows an authored one as written. Omitted when false.

label.description: The author's label for the step (`samples.labels`), else one made from the group name.

scope.description: Whether a step runs once per sample or once for the whole study (open enum).
